messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered — embeddings-route (prod) latency spike + 5xx surge. Affected route: /v1/embeddings/global, top offending tenant: tenant-238. Paging mike-oncall.

mike-oncall: saw it, joining. oncall now. investigating logs + topological view.

jordan-sre: looking at kube autoscaler and GPU pool metrics — embeddings queue depth jumped x8, tail latencies > 6s. error pattern = 502 from model workers.

sarah-eng: can we confirm whether this is a model OOM or upstream request flood?

jordan-sre: initial traces show many small requests (embedding small vectors) but QPS spike from a handful of IPs tied to tenant-238. not OOM yet, just overload + retries.

mike-oncall: customer-facing impact? any 4xx/5xx user-visible incidents?

alice-pm: support queue shows multiple clients at Acme using embeddings timed out; ticket count rising. severity = user-visible latency/timeouts.

jordan-sre: plan: 1) ceiling tenant-238 embeddings qps 2) temporarily carve dedicated burst for chat routes if needed 3) disable rerank route for tenant-238 (low priority) until embeddings recovery.

sarah-eng: propose config change: set per-tenant limit --route=embeddings --tenant=tenant-238 --qps=20 and reduce concurrent-seqs to 2. also add a reject-with-429 policy so clients see fast failures.

mike-oncall: agree. schedule quick change via admin console. tagging ops-bot to apply.

ops-bot: executing change: `redwoodctl quota set --route embeddings --tenant tenant-238 --qps 20 --concurrency 2 --policy reject`

ops-bot: change applied (commit 3f9b1). propagation to edge: ~5s.

jordan-sre: seeing immediate drop in tail latency for embeddings from the tenant, overall queue depth falling. 5xxs still slightly elevated but trending down.

alice-pm: support notified: "We applied a temporary rate limit to your embeddings calls to protect platform stability. We're working on gradual restore."

sarah-eng: also toggled route-level priority to favor chat-heavy routes: lowered embeddings route weight on routing layer for the next 10m. command: `routectl weight-set embeddings 0.6 chat 1.0`

mike-oncall: good. any need to disable rerank globally? i prefer targeted disable for tenant.

jordan-sre: tenant-specific rerank disable executed: `redwoodctl feature-toggle --tenant tenant-238 --feature rerank --state off`

ops-bot: feature toggle success.

alice-pm: customer comms drafted, will share in #customer-success after this thread.

mike-oncall: monitoring: errors down ~75% for tenant-238, overall 5xx rate back to baseline window. keeping mitigation in place for +15m then re-evaluate.

sarah-eng: we'll also post a follow-up to telemetry to flag any regression if we restore to pre-change qps. add an eval job to run a small synthetic prompt set vs embeddings to check quality and latency.

jordan-sre: oncall handoff in 30m to night shift. leaving runbook notes: change-id 3f9b1, tenant=tenant-238, actions taken: quota set, rerank disabled, route weight lowered.

mike-oncall: thanks. handing to jordan for overnight watch. :thumbsup:

jordan-sre: taking handoff. will monitor alerts and escalate if 5xx > baseline*1.5 or latency p50 > 1s for embeddings route.

incident-bot: Note: incident severity set to SEV-2. PagerDuty: acknowledged by mike-oncall.

ops-bot: postmortem reminder scheduled in #postmortems in 24h; include: root cause hypothesis (tenant retry storm), mitigation timeline, long-term fixes (per-tenant ingress shaping, adaptive token-bucket limits, backpressure signals).

alice-pm: filing a CS outreach task to Acme asking for traffic pattern details and suggested client-side backoff.

mike-oncall: closing thread for now; leave mitigation in place until steady. will reopen if metrics regress. :white_check_mark:
